verdict.rationale: Qodo offers some on-demand control — the CLI lets you review changes before opening a PR, and a .pr_agent.toml config file supports repo/org-level customization — but there is no direct evidence of draft-PR skipping, branch-based trigger filters, or label-triggered runs; docs actually state reviews run automatically on every PR by default. missing for 10: explicit draft-skip setting, branch/label-based trigger rules, documented manual re-trigger command distinct from CLI pre-PR review.
